content.title: How to watch LIU vs. Arizona men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 20
content.text: The top-seeded Arizona Wildcats (32-2) and the No. 16 Long Island Sharks (24-10) square off on Friday for a spot in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. The opening-round matchup tips off at 1:35 p.m. ET.How to watch Long Island Sharks vs. Arizona Wildcats Venue: Viejas Arena Time: 1:35 p.m. ET TV: TNT Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. LIU vs. Arizona odds Spread: Arizona -30.5 (-112), LIU +30.5 (-111) Favorite Moneyline: Arizona -100000 Underdog Moneyline: LIU +5225 Total: 147.5 Total Over Odds: -113 Total Under Odds: -110 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Arizona is outscoring opponents by 17.3 points per game with a +590 scoring differential overall. It puts up 86.1 points per game (13th in college basketball) and allows 68.8 per contest (52nd in college basketball). Arizona hits 5.9 three-pointers per game (334th in college basketball), 1.4 fewer than its opponents (7.3). LIU’s +101 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 3.0 points per game) is a result of putting up 74.1 points per game (229th in college basketball) while giving up 71.1 per outing (103rd in college basketball). LIU hits 6.0 three-pointers per game (326th in college basketball) at a 36.1% rate (57th in college basketball), compared to the 6.1 its opponents make, shooting 31.9% from beyond the arc.
